  • Method Details

    • connectionHealthControl

      public void connectionHealthControl()
      This method is used to attempt to reconnect to the server after the original connection has failed. It tries to connect to the server a certain number of times (thresholdTries). If it can't make the connection, it waits for a certain amount of time (secondsForReconnection) before trying again using the timer() method.

    • putInTheOutGoingFileQueue

      public void putInTheOutGoingFileQueue(Command command)
      This method is called by ClientSerializer, it is used to put a JSON file in the OutGoingFileQueue. It uses a BlockingQueue to ensure thread safety. If the queue is full, it waits until space becomes available.
      Parameters:
      command - The JSON file to be put in the OutGoingFileQueue.
